name: @rreusser/blahpack
description: JavaScript implementations of BLAS and LAPACK routines, translated from the Fortran reference implementations

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:lint
scripts.check:modules: node bin/break-mutants.mjs --changed --check && npm run mutants:value && node bin/workspace-guard.mjs --changed --check && node bin/workspace-optimum.mjs --changed --check && node bin/workspace-minimum.mjs --changed --check && node bin/coverage.mjs --changed --check --uncovered && node bin/wrapper-replay.mjs --changed --check && bin/bench-smoke.sh --changed
scripts.lint:learnings: ! grep -rl 'TODO: Fill in' lib/*/*/LEARNINGS.md lib/*/*/LEARNINGS.integrated.md 2>/dev/null | grep . && echo 'All LEARNINGS files filled in' || (echo 'FAIL: Unfilled LEARNINGS file found:' && grep -rl 'TODO: Fill in' lib/*/*/LEARNINGS.md lib/*/*/LEARNINGS.integrated.md && exit 1)
scripts.dev: npm run bundle:notebook && npm run bundle:naca && npm run bundle:pseudospectra && vite --port 5174
